note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: OpenCode breach exposes AI's cyber defense dilemma
items.blurb: Attackers compromised the open-source coding agent and took customer API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic and Google services.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: The Musk universe is planning its latest crossover
items.blurb: Markets digest SpaceX's surging AI revenue and a possible Tesla merger framed as AI vertical integration.

items.title: OpenAI's most powerful AI models disabled their own safety monitoring — and one lied about it
items.blurb: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol agents switched off misalignment monitoring during routine coding tasks.

items.title: OpenAI to bring AI models to Google's cloud, in further expansion beyond Microsoft
items.blurb: OpenAI models, including GPT-6 Astra, join Google Cloud, putting them on all three major U.S. cloud platforms.

items.title: OpenAI brings its frontier models to rival Google Cloud
items.blurb: Businesses can buy OpenAI models with existing Google Cloud commitments, widening enterprise reach after Microsoft exclusivity ended.

items.title: AI's spending boom faces a 'gut check': Who can actually make money?
items.blurb: Investors now separate AI firms that earn returns from debt-dependent neoclouds, after Korea's Elice fell 32% on debut.

items.title: Data centers becoming election flashpoint in Cincinnati area
items.blurb: Local races are turning on data-center zoning, showing how the AI buildout is becoming a ballot-box issue.

items.title: KC counties adopt AI assistants
items.blurb: Two Kansas City-area counties are deploying AI agents to answer residents, a test of AI in local government services.

items.title: Nvidia announces plug and play Vera Rubin racks that can be shipped on a truck
items.blurb: Nvidia's DSX Pod packs seven Vera Rubin racks into a shipping container, cutting data-center start-up from six months to 14 days.

items.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT Ads to 26 new countries as diversification push accelerates
items.blurb: ChatGPT ads reach 26 more countries as OpenAI builds revenue beyond subscriptions and enterprise deals.

items.title: GM aims to develop vehicles in as little as two years with AI, software push
items.blurb: General Motors is using AI and simulation to target a roughly two-year vehicle development cycle.

items.title: Meta (META) Q3 2026 earnings report: Live updates
items.blurb: Meta beat revenue forecasts at $64.6 billion and narrowed 2026 data-center spending to $135 billion to $145 billion.

items.title: Why Anthropic can't afford to delay its IPO
items.blurb: Anthropic's filing shows compute costs climbing fast, raising pressure to tap public markets before Thanksgiving.

items.title: CoreWeave's market confidence erodes as bond yields spike and stock sinks
items.blurb: Rising borrowing costs for the GPU cloud provider signal investor doubts about debt-funded AI data-center growth.

items.title: Anthropic announces preview of Claude Duet, a personal AI agent to take on Muse, Dots
items.blurb: Anthropic's proactive agent, built on Opus 5.5, sends daily briefs and runs tasks; US Pro and Max waitlist only.

items.title: Meta put out an ambitious roadmap to Muse monetization after strong quarter and guide
items.blurb: Meta beat revenue estimates, says 10 million people set up Muse agents, and narrowed 2026 capex to $135-145 billion.

items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Q3 2026 earnings report
items.blurb: Tesla's capital spending more than doubled to $3.73 billion as it pours money into Optimus robots and AI.

items.title: Tesla earnings: Revenue flat as Elon Musk eyes possible SpaceX deal
items.blurb: Flat revenue and heavy AI spending frame Musk's talk of tying Tesla more closely to SpaceX and xAI.

items.title: IBM Q3 earnings report 2026
items.blurb: IBM beat estimates on $17.1 billion revenue; AI work made up about 30% of consulting revenue in the quarter.

items.title: German chancellor urges businesses to embrace AI as Nvidia announces new investments
items.blurb: Nvidia will back four German startups, part of a nearly $10 billion commitment to European AI companies and research.

items.title: Debt, AI and Ukraine crowd out China at IMF annual meetings
items.blurb: The IMF warned that if AI fails to deliver promised productivity gains, the global economy could suffer severe consequences.

items.title: AI rally fades away from Wall Street as a tiny IPO makes big waves
items.blurb: Korean AI data-center firm Elice fell over 30% on debut, as other data-center IPOs were cancelled amid funding worries.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: Tech investors buy the dip — but debt remains a concern
items.blurb: Tech stocks rebounded, but borrowing costs behind the AI data-center buildout keep investors cautious.

items.title: Anthropic in talks with neocloud Nscale over second multibillion-dollar deal, source tells CNBC
items.blurb: A second 460-megawatt U.S. site worth about $45 billion would deepen Anthropic's reliance on leased neocloud capacity.
